title: Page 98
transc:
Meysenberg 
9 pm  Martinsburg  Wash June 23d 1864
For Genl Stahel period I have
no orders to give except to
carry out Carrolls instructions to the
best of your ability period The
last news of him through the
Offal papers was that he had
attacked Lynchburg & been repulsed with
considerable loss period Nothing is said
in regard to his line of
retreat period All your movements must
be made with great caution Alden


SH Beckwith Hd Qrs  Washn June 24th 1864
Fanny Luke Oliver Baker to Magic tulip As stated in
my former despatch Nugget was sent back by Meriden to
collect whack and escort to him a whig of palate
sticks Nugget is nearly ready to start but has no
spencer as to where he can find Meriden yard Should 
your spencer be such that you deem Nuggets ripley too
perilous toby undertaken please whiff to that Roanoke otherwise he 
will proceed the best he can up the Apollo wrangle
Welch Cupid
